author: Contributor 79
about: Volter's releases on npm and the applications that read them (journeys/customer-life.outline.md): the @volter organization and the World application's token, pack-release's npm view and publishes, tabnode's documents, pinned versions and tarballs, Substrate's image build, Volter Harness's update check on both channels, the catalog index's provenance check, a second release, a Twenty app found, resolved and installed through Twenty's marketplace, a private Twenty app its own team installs with its registry token, and the catalog release's move to CI with provenance, refused once for the package.json's missing repository, and the index check reading the attestations.

steps.name: Monday 5 January, 09:00: Volter releases its twins and its harness to npm
Dana Ruiz signs up and creates a package-publishing token on npmjs.com, valid through 1 March
and creates the volter organization, which owns the @volter scope
A World application's token, as the World issues NPM_TOKEN at boot
A second boot issues the same token
The World application's user is in no organization: its publish into @volter is refused
